title: Luna Fire & Life Safety System V1
status: REFERENCE DESIGN — not procurement, not certified fire engineering, not a certified fire alarm/control system

safetyAuthorityRule.statement: Oyi is not the certified fire panel. Twin geometry is not the certified fire panel. Simulation is not certification. Fire/life-safety decisions and interlocks remain under approved life-safety controllers and engineered systems.
enforcement: LUNA-B1-FIRE-PANEL-01.availableCommands is empty by construction — silence/reset deliberately never mapped to any runtime command
explainFireState() output always includes the literal string '(reference simulation)'
reference incident only triggered through the existing scenario/runtime architecture — no separate Fire simulator

newCanonicalAssetsJustification: none created — all 7 assets needed for the reference incident and both networks already existed in the catalog from Phase 3C/4/13

alarmDetectionNetwork.topology: LUNA-B1-FIRE-PANEL-01 (controller) <- LUNA-GROUND-FIRE-DET-01 / LUNA-L06-APT-A-ENTRY-SMOKE-01 (detectors, parentRef to panel/branch chain)

derivedFields.panel.alarm_active: boolean, true if any detector alarm/smoke is true
derivedFields.panel.active_zone_ref: ref of the originating detector, or null

alarmDetectionNetwork.notCoupledTo: hydraulic network — starting/stopping the pump never changes alarm_active, and an alarm never auto-starts the pump

hydraulicSuppressionNetwork.topology: LUNA-B1-FIRE-TANK-01 (storage) -> LUNA-B1-FIRE-PUMP-01 (pump, supplied_by tank) -> LUNA-RISER-FIRE-01 (riser) -> LUNA-L06-FIRE-BRANCH-01 (floor zone)

newRelationship.label: fire water supplied by
newRelationship.note: pump's parentRef is the panel (alarm/control hierarchy); this typed edge is the separate, correct hydraulic-source documentation — same precedent as Water/Electrical

buildingFireResolver.excludedStatesReason: nothing in the current canonical catalog legitimately models a distinct investigation/supervisory/partial-isolation stage — not inventing standards-specific terminology unsupported by the model

fields.affectedLevelRef: string | null — resolved from the originating device's ownerLevelRef
fields.fireWaterAvailable: boolean — structural baseline (tank registered), not live sensor telemetry

eventModel.pubSub: reuses the existing provider notify()/subscribe() mechanism — no second event system
eventModel.edgeDetection: module-level lastFireAlarm/lastFireTrouble/lastFirePumpRunning trackers — events log once per genuine transition, never per poll

independentHalves: hydraulic recompute — not coupled to each other, matching real fire-pump pressure-drop-triggered behavior

controlBoard.summaryWidget: FireStatusSummary — reused headerContent? slot, dom hooks [data-fire-status-summary]/[data-fire-state]
controlBoard.activeIncidentSummary: ActiveIncidentSummary component, renders only when fireState !== 'normal' — origin, affected level, device count, live event narrative
controlBoard.commandPhilosophy: fire panel exposes zero commands by construction (silence/reset unmapped) — 'not every asset gets ON/OFF' is satisfied automatically, not special-cased

equipment: FirePumpGeometry — pump/motor assembly with discharge manifold
FireTankGeometry — cylindrical storage vessel with support skirt
physicalGeometry.riser: engine-shared RiserShaft, shape='round' (default, unchanged), pressurized-driven glow via the existing energized prop (semantically repurposed, no shape change)

oyiIntelligence.newMatcher: matchFireStatus in lunaIntentParser.ts, inserted after matchBuildingPower
newVocabulary: fire-water/fire water compound patterns (fixed a system-resolution bug)
oyiIntelligence.newExplainFunction: explainFireState(fire) in lunaExplain.ts — always includes '(reference simulation)'
oyiIntelligence.vocabularyBugFixed: findByPattern's longest-pattern-first sort resolved 'fire-water' to the water system alias (substring match on 'water') instead of fire; fixed by adding explicit longer fire-water/fire water patterns to the fire system alias
targetPhrasesVerified: What is the fire status of Luna?
Show the fire-water path to L06.
What devices responded to this incident?
Are there any fire system faults?

representationPolicy.consumerBoundary: B1 fire plant (panel/pump/tank) HIDDEN for all resident identities; 6A smoke detector FULL_3D only for the assigned resident, HIDDEN for any other resident

disclosedDataFix.reason: pre-existing gap discovered via a failing browser test — fire detectors are Facility/life-safety responsibility regardless of unit location, same category as the already-allowlisted meters/DBs/circuits
disclosedDataFix.scope: additive DATA only, not a RepresentationPolicy.ts code change
disclosedDataFix.knownRelatedGapNotFixed: KITCHEN-LEAK-01 (water leak sensor) has the same allowlist gap — identified but left unfixed as out of scope for this Fire-only phase

incidentSimulation.mechanism: existing smoke-alert scenario (lunaScenarios.ts) — patches smoke:true then calls lunaRuntimeInternals.recomputeFireNetwork()
sequence: Oyi/Control Board/event log reflect the same live truth
incidentSimulation.recovery: clearing smoke + recompute returns fireState to normal, logs 'Alarm cleared'

referenceIncidentLocation: L06 / Apartment 6A (the one location with a fully detailed canonical MEP presence)

unresolvedDesignDecisions.DD11: Fire engineering — pump sizing/duty, tank capacity/replenishment, sprinkler/hose-reel coverage and activation hydraulics, zoning beyond L06, detector spacing/coverage standard, manufacturer/model. Entirely unresolved; no sprinkler activation fabricated.
unresolvedDesignDecisions.DD15: Structural/fire-rating coordination beyond what Phase 13 already modeled. Unchanged, unresolved.
unresolvedDesignDecisions.DD20: Elevator fire-mode/recall authority. Not touched — no fire recall logic, firefighter lift certification, evacuation lift behavior, or emergency control authority fabricated. Service/Fire Lift boundary remains as previously documented.

tests.browser: scripts/verifyFireBrowser.mjs — 16 checks including all 12 required screenshots and Elevator/Water/Electrical regression
